title: 12V Battery Voltage Sag During Wake
app: Tesla Fleet API / TeslaMate, Rivian telemetry, ChargePoint session exports, PlugShare trip logs, Smartcar, and OBD-II / home-charger data via APIs, CSV exports, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=obd:pid metric=12v_battery
| bin _time span=1d
| stats min(voltage_v) as min_voltage_v by vin _time
| where min_voltage_v<12.0
| sort min_voltage_v
description: Uses OBD-II 12V telemetry telemetry to monitor lowest auxiliary-battery voltage seen during daily wake cycles in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for early hints that the low-voltage battery is weakening, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest OBD-II 12V telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It frames lowest auxiliary-battery voltage seen during daily wake cycles so you can spot early hints that the low-voltage battery is weakening before it becomes annoying.
